title: The minimal volume of stable surfaces of rank one
summary: We determine the minimal volume of a stable surface of rank one, and show that the surface attaining this minimum is unique up to isomorphism. This resolves a conjecture of Alexeev and the second author. Of independent interest, the decisive step of the proof uses a plurigenus inequality re-derived by an AI chatbot and applied as a pluricanonical filter; we further apply this filter to rule out additional cases in the classification of small-volume threefolds of general type, and in Kollár's algebraic Montgomery--Yang problem.
